definitions.gloss: old times, the past, long ago
definitions.explanation: A time in the distant past.

examples.english: It was different in the past.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}の{友達|ともだち}に{会|あ}った。
{昔|むかし}、ここに{城|しろ}があった。
examples.english: Long ago, there was a castle here.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{昔|むかし}のことをよく{話|はな}してくれる。
examples.english: My grandfather often tells me about the old days.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}は{電話|でんわ}もインターネットもなかったから、{手紙|てがみ}を{書|か}いて{連絡|れんらく}していた。
examples.english: In the old days there were no phones or internet, so people communicated by writing letters.

notes:
{昔|むかし} refers to the past, ranging from personal memories to ancient times.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {昔|むかし}の{友達|ともだち}: old friend
- {昔|むかし}から: since long ago
- {昔|むかし}は〜だった: in the old days it was...

STORYTELLING:
- {昔々|むかしむかし}: once upon a time (story opening)
- {昔話|むかしばなし}: folktale, old story

COMPOUNDS:
- {大昔|おおむかし}: ancient times, long long ago
- {昔|むかし}{風|ふう}: old-fashioned style
- {昔|むかし}{馴染|なじ}み: old acquaintance

CONTRAST:
- {昔|むかし}: the past, old times (general)
- {以前|いぜん}: before, previously (more specific timeframe)
- {古代|こだい}: ancient times (historical period)
- {今|いま}: now ↔ {昔|むかし}: the past
